Love in the Time of Fishing is a Event Quest that occurs in Riccioli Islands, Rinascita, [[{{{nation}}}]].

Summary[]

Following Captain Ahab's instructions, you and Phoebe manage to find his old First Mate, Starbuck, but the man seems to have fallen under some kind of enchantment. To help Starbuck come to his senses, you decide to locate his Gondola for clues.
You and Phoebe find Starbuck's lost Gondola. Having theorized that Starbuck's enchantment has something to do with the fish he was holding, the two of you begin brainstorming a plan to get it off his hands.
You and Phoebe finally manage to grab the fish from Starbuck, and the First Mate's sanity is restored. Starbuck claims he once saw Cetus the Tidebreaker at a place called Serene Bay, with a large fish swimming alongside it. He hands you the lighthouse key Captain Ahab entrusted in his care before you departed.

Steps[]

  1. Head to the dock and get ready to depart
  2. Complete Requests to increase your Fame to Level 3 or above
  3. Search for Ahab near the dock in Riccioli Port
  4. Find a shipwright to learn more about the large ship
  5. Collect Palm Tree Logs and Riccioli Fishery Coins for Queequeg
    1. Gather 50 Palm Logs
    2. Earn 500 Riccioli Fishery Coins
  6. Go to the dock, prepare for departure, and travel to Helm Village
  7. Travel to Helm Village
  8. Search for Starbuck
  9. Set Sail from the dock and find the abandoned gondola
  10. Go to the location where the Gondola is trapped
  11. Clear the rubble and free the Gondola
  12. Complete Requests or update the Index to increase your Fame to level 6 or above
  13. Wait for the evening (or adjust the time to 19:00-05:00)
  14. Fish for large catches at designated Fishing Spot
  15. Head back to Helm Village and locate Starbuck
  16. Use the key to light up the lighthouse in Helm Village

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Completing "Search for Starbuck" step awards "Sweet Puff".
  • Completing "Fish for large catches at designated Fishing Spot" step awards Familiar-looking Large FishFamiliar-looking Large Fish Familiar-looking Large Fish.
  • Completing "Head back to Helm Village and locate Starbuck" step awards Helm Village Lighthouse Key.
  • Completing the quest awards Pequod Blueprint: Basic.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
A sailor named Starbuck has fallen into mental turmoil—rumor has it, a fish drove him to this state...
(Speak with Ahab)
Ahab: My leg... Where's my leg... Fetch me the harpoon...
Ahab: ...First Mate... Oil... Where's my oil...?
Ahab: Ahoy. How did it go? Pull in a pretty big haul, did ye?
Ahab: I'm gettin' closer to findin' the Tidebreaker meself. Just head over to the Helm Village and look for... What's his name again...?
Ahab: Oh, right! Starbuck!
Ahab: The man's lost a couple of his marbles these past few weeks. People say he only started acting up after catchin' a glimpse of the Tidebreaker. Anyway, tell him I sent ye.
Ahab: Also, notice that ship?
Ahab: If you want to catch yourself a real prize, ye'll be needin' that one. She's still waitin' on repairs, but the watermen can fill ye in on that.
(Talk to the shipwright
Queequeg: Ah, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)? Ahab said of you.
Queequeg: Bring me wood.
What?
Queequeg: Wood. To fix ship.
(Give materials to Queequeg)
Queequeg: Now not enough.
Queequeg: You bring material. Queequeg fix ship.
(Head to the designated location)
Starbuck: Hehe... Oh, my sweet...
Starbuck: No one else knows. It's just between us.
Starbuck: Wait for my return, my darling... fiancée...
Phoebe: Er, excuse me, sir? Are you the one who witnessed Cetus the Tidebreaker?
Starbuck: Hmm? Yes, that's me! Are you here to witness our union? Marvelous! Come, according to tradition, a wedding witness must be present.
Phoebe: A wedding witness? Well, the Codex does allow acolytes to serve as witnesses during weddings.
What makes you want to marry a fish?!
He's certainly not acting like himself...
Starbuck: Hehe... Hehehe...
Phoebe: Is he... under some kind of enchantment? I've read of symptoms like this in the Order's archives before.
Phoebe: O Imperator's blessings, gaze upon this...
Rover: W-wait...
Phoebe: Huh? I did what was written in the archives...
Starbuck: Ouch!? You... I'm...
Starbuck: Golden white... Jellyfish... Pitch black... A large fish... Huh? You're human... I'm a fish... No wait... My fish...
Starbuck: Ow, my head hurts... Who are you?
I think it worked!
Mind if I give him another smack?
Starbuck: Where the hell's my boat? And how did I get here... What?
Starbuck: The fish... My, oh, my... From Serene Bay... The fish... Heeheehee...
Phoebe: He's at it again! Here I go!
Fisherman's Plushie: ...!
Phoebe: Oh? It's you.
Phoebe: Is your leg okay now?
You know this little guy?
Phoebe: I treated their broken leg from a Gondola accident back at the market.
Fisherman's Plushie: ...!
Phoebe: Did... Mr. Coffin ask you to come here?
Phoebe: I think they're trying to say that Mr. Starbuck's Gondola might know something. They're stranded on a reef nearby.
Phoebe: And Mr. Starbuck has been like this for two weeks now...
Fisherman's Plushie: ...! ...!
Phoebe: You want us to use these to free the Gondola?
Phoebe: Hmmm, I fear Mr. Starbuck might not withstand any more of the Order's disenchantment tricks anyway.
It does look rather painful.
It's for his own good.
Phoebe: In that brief moment when Mr. Starbuck seemed to recover, he mentioned his Gondola and a place called Serene Bay.
Phoebe: Finding that boat and uncovering the cause behind his enchantment might be a good starting point.
Good idea.
To the Gondola!
Starbuck: Heehee... Yes, we must have fireworks at our wedding... "Sweetened fireworks"...
(Clear the rubble and free the Gondola)
Phoebe: Over there!
Phoebe: Huh? Why is there a sweet scent in the air...?
Phoebe: The Gondola is drifting back!
Abandoned Gondola: ...! ...!
The rescued Gondola appears to be shouting something.
Phoebe: You came across a "siren"? A creature with a human body and a fishtail?
Could it be Lorelei?
Isn't she supposed to be in Nimbus Sanctum?
Phoebe: Could there be another being like Lorelei?
Abandoned Gondola: ...?
Phoebe: I suspect that the fish we saw earlier is connected to this "siren."
Phoebe: There's got to be a reason it stayed fresh after all these weeks.
Phoebe: This means we need to think of a way to get that fish out of Mr. Starbuck's hands.
Then I propose...
It's time for a little switcheroo.
We catch one that looks similar and call it a day.
Phoebe: Would that work?
We're running low on options here.
They're all fish, aren't they?
Phoebe: Well, only one way to find out.
(Fish for large catches at designated Fishing Spot)
A large dark gray fish flies onto your boat...
It does look similar to the fish Starbuck is holding. Maybe you can swap the fish in Starbuck's hands with this one.
(Head to the designated location)
Starbuck: Hehehe...
Starbuck: Oh? My dear witness, have you seen my fiancée around?
Starbuck: Hehehe... You... What are you up to?
Starbuck: Help! Somebody help!!!
Rover: Phoebe! Grab its tail!
Phoebe: I-It's so slippery! Disenchant!
Starbuck: Thieves! You filthy thieves!
Starbuck: Ugh... You... My head...
Starbuck: Who are you? What am I doing with this fish?
Phoebe: Mr. Starbuck? Captain Ahab asked us to come find you.
Starbuck: Old Ahab? Wait, what's going on here?
Do you know anything about this blue fish?
Do you remember what happened to Cetus the Tidebreaker?
Starbuck: All I remember is being out at sea fishing not long ago.
Starbuck: But all I could hear was a song, drawing me in. It felt like my whole body was being beckoned to follow that tune.
Starbuck: The next thing I knew, I was drifting right out of Serene Bay, where the Tidebreaker is said to slumber.
Starbuck: The singing was still there, like it was rising from the depths. I swear I caught a glimpse of the Cetus's shadow... then another shadow of a massive fish.
Starbuck: Oh, the curves of that shadow. A true beauty...
Starbuck: I tossed everything I had into the sea, anything that could serve as bait, but still, it wouldn't bite.
Starbuck: Then, I felt a tug on the line as the singing grew louder... and everything went blank after that.
Did you catch this blue fish?
Starbuck: Yes! That's the one!
Starbuck: Wait, wait! Where is it...
Starbuck: Key! The key... Blast it, where'd that key go?
Starbuck: The key... I used it as bait...
Whoa, whoa! You're not—
Starbuck reaches inside the blue fish and pulls out a key...
Starbuck: Aha! I knew it! Molto bene! Got gobbed up by the fish!
Starbuck: Old Ahab had me keep it. You'll be needing it too, yes?
A key covered in rust. Seems like it's seen better days...
Starbuck: I can't recall much after that, but no doubt the Tidebreaker did make an appearance in Serene Bay.
Starbuck: If you're looking for it, go take a look around the bay. Oh, and thanks for the help...
Phoebe: Are you...
Starbuck: I'm forty-seven years old this year. After all these years at sea, I've caught more fish than you can imagine.
Starbuck: But the right fish and the right person have yet to cross my path.
Starbuck: Oh, but this beautiful lady here—
Ahem.
We should get going, Phoebe.
Phoebe: Farewell, Mr. Starbuck.
Phoebe: I wish you the best! May Imper... May the sea bring you blessings!
Starbuck: Uh, right... Okay then...
Phoebe: Let's light up the lighthouses on this island as Captain Ahab instructed.
Phoebe: After that, we should go visit that Serene Bay Mr. Starbuck talked about.
